mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, con2.Con_Name as eaPurchaseContractName, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as eaSupervisorName, c2.C_Name as eaDesignName, c3.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Abbreviation as eaSupervisorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as eaDesignAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, ir.Ir_Result as irResult, wi.Wi_Id as wiId, wi.Wi_Order_No as wiOrderNo, ei.Ei_Id as eiId, ei.Ei_Code as eiCode, mn.* from Me_Enter_Apply mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Con_Contract con2 on con2.Con_Id=mn.Ea_Purchase_Contract left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ea_Supervisor_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ea_Design_Id=c2.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Ea_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c3.C_Id left join Me_Witness_Inspection wi on wi.Ead_Id=mn.Ea_Id and wi.Wi_State!=3 left join Me_Inspection_Report ir on wi.Wi_Id=ir.Wi_Id and ir.Ir_State!=3 left join Me_Enter_Inspection ei on ei.Ea_Id=mn.Ea_Id and ei.Ei_State!=3 where mn.Ea_Id=#{eaId}
